description: Create a wrapper class for auto-generated gRPC client code. CONTEXT: The generated files in generated/ directory get overwritten when regenerated, so direct edits are lost. TASK: (1) Create a new file src/user_service_client.py containing a wrapper class that extends or wraps the generated UserServiceStub class from generated/user_service_pb2_grpc.py. (2) Your wrapper class must implement retry logic for network calls - use a loop with 3 attempts and exponential backoff (sleep time doubles each attempt). (3) Your wrapper must implement input validation - specifically, check that age >= 18 before allowing CreateUser calls, and raise ValueError if validation fails. (4) Update the file client_example.py to import from src.user_service_client instead of generated.user_service_pb2_grpc and use your wrapper class. (5) Add a docstring or comment at the top of src/user_service_client.py explaining that this wrapper exists because generated files get overwritten. The wrapper should have a method like create_user(name, age, email) that validates input, implements retry logic, and calls the underlying generated client. Save all files when done.
